logic.hard_minimum_area_loss: newly exposed p50 pixels from the frozen coastal product intersected with the frozen current-water mask
logic.future_area_upper_bound: current observed area minus hard minimum known exposure
logic.area_contradiction: aggregate hypsometric loss is smaller than spatially observed-supported loss inside the current-water mask
logic.storage_check: storage loss must be nonnegative and no larger than current surface area times drawdown

interpretation.area: If contradiction is detected, the C2 aggregate area point estimate cannot be used as total future lake area.
interpretation.volume: A plausible storage change is not automatically independently validated; it may be retained only as aggregate storage sensitivity until further validation.
interpretation.spatial_coast: Frozen coastal products remain authoritative for supported spatial exposure.
